citations.claim: initial state has zero velocity and zero controller force
at first violating step controller force 6.5 exceeds fmax 5

counterfactual.change: Set controller noise from 1 to 0; velocity-error law then commands force within fmax, removing the violation.

explanation: With seeded sensor noise=1, the noisy velocity measurement inflates the velocity error so kp*error exceeds fmax. The noise contribution is added after / outside the force saturation clamp (6.5 > fmax 5 at step 1), violating controller_force_limit. With noise=0 the same scenario commands force within limit and passes.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body starts on the left side of the arena in step 0 and remains essentially in the same position in step 1, far from the green waypoint cross on the right. No collision, wall penetration, or large visible motion occurs between the two frames.
